Video is shown on the car screen only when the car is confirmed parked. The app reads the car\'s speed through Android Auto and, if the car does not report it, the phone\'s GPS speed. With neither, video stays off. Nothing is sent anywhere.

1. Android Auto settings → tap Version 10× → Developer settings → enable Unknown sources (needed for adb-installed apps).
2. Android Auto settings → Customise launcher → enable AA Tube.
3. Connect to the car (wireless) and open AA Tube from the car launcher.
4. If AA Tube does not appear in the car launcher, a sideloaded APK may be filtered by Android Auto: install through a Play Console internal testing track (see README).
5. YouTube TV pairing: switch to YouTube TV mode on the car while parked, open its Settings → Link with TV code, then on the passenger phone YouTube → Cast → Link with TV code.
